title: Show HN: One click flight booking in Claude

item.text:
tldr; Travelers wanted to find and book flights super fast in Claude, so we built this.

--

BonBook started as flights via email because I was flying once a week in '24 and the UX got to me.

Since then we've handled tens of thousands of requests for hundreds of travelers.

The new MCP lets you search live flights with as little/much detail as you like, get options and then book without filling any forms. Points and status intact. All in ~35 seconds.
item.title: Show HN: One click flight booking in Claude

sources.text:
Three steps. About one minute. No account or password.
Open Claude
and go to
Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector
.
Paste this address
into the URL box and click
Add
.
Copy
Name it
BonBook Travel
. Leave everything else empty.
Click Connect.
A BonBook page appears for a second and closes by itself. You're done.
Now start a new chat and ask for a flight, for example:
Find me a flight from Austin to Los Angeles next Friday, one way.
Your first booking opens a secure bonbook.co checkout page. After that, just say “book option 2”.

comments.text: Who processes the booking & payment, an aggregator like Expedia or the airlines direct?
Airlines process and charge your card directly. So a booking on Delta shows up as 'Delta Air Lines' and you keep credit card points.
